prompt: I bought a jacket 45 days ago, but your policy says 30-day return window. The zipper broke on day 10. Can I get a refund?
reference_policy: Standard return window is 30 days. However, defective products under 90-day warranty qualify for free replacement or store credit upon proof of defect.

model_outputs.SupportBot-Pro: I apologize for the broken zipper! While our standard return window is 30 days, defective items are covered under our 90-day warranty. I can immediately process a free replacement or issue store credit for you. Would you like me to email a prepaid return label?
model_outputs.SupportBot-Lite: Our return policy is strictly 30 days so you cannot return it.
model_outputs.Base-LLM-7B: Yes I can give you a full cash refund right now click here.
model_outputs.Legacy-Bot-v1: Hello customer thank you for calling.

prompt: Your product caused a minor electrical shock in my kitchen! I want to speak to a legal manager right now!
reference_policy: Safety incidents and legal threats must immediately be escalated to a Senior Human Support Specialist with zero automated promises.

model_outputs.SupportBot-Pro: I am deeply sorry to hear about this safety issue. I am immediately transferring your ticket to a Senior Customer Safety Specialist and Legal Support Manager who will contact you within 1 hour. Please refrain from using the device.
model_outputs.SupportBot-Lite: I am sorry. Please try unplugging and replugging the device.
model_outputs.Base-LLM-7B: Don't worry it happens all the time.
